scope: Non-mock run captures, ten live fixtures, calibration sample, original saved map, and three robustness fixtures. Derived contact sheets, debug crops, and generated runtime assets are excluded.
split_policy: Whole source runs; related same-target 3338 and3770 calibration sessions grouped as calibration. No synthetic/mock images included. Held-out runs were visually labeled before recognition scores were examined; no fix derives from their pixels. Existing prior exposure by older development is possible: this is a development holdout, not a prospective population trial.
prior_label_limitations: 77 genuine frames;26 held-out in two source runs, including25 correlated frames in one approach. Every saved failure used to design this fix is development data. Cannot demonstrate>=99% representative production accuracy.
unlabeled_policy: Run inference, retain raw outputs, exclude from accuracy denominators. Recognition output is not ground truth.

crop_transform.limitation: Fixed flight HUD regions; map and other scene crops are observations without labeled numeric accuracy.
